release_notes:
A fixes update.

Fixed a rare error message that could appear right after an update or on first start, when antivirus briefly holds the app's settings file. If Windows blocks a settings save later on, you now get a clear note instead of an error.

"Launch on Windows startup" now shows what Windows will actually do and respects your choice in Task Manager. Uninstalling now removes the startup entry.

Programs and Features now shows the right version after an in-app update.

The trial-ended and trial-reminder windows now fit smaller screens and higher display scaling.

Duplicate Finder now keeps the original ("photo.jpg") rather than the copy ("photo (2).jpg") when both have the same date.

Macro recording handles the Windows key and Esc correctly, and a macro that can't run on its own schedule now tells you so.
